title: EventBus has no way to unsubscribe a handler
body: `EventBus` in `signals/bus.py` lets handlers subscribe to an event name but never lets them leave. Please make `subscribe(event, handler)` return an unsubscribe function. Calling it removes that subscription, so the handler is not called by later `publish` calls; calling it again does nothing. If the same handler was subscribed twice, each returned function removes only its own subscription. A handler may unsubscribe itself, or another handler, while `publish` is running: every handler that was subscribed when that `publish` call started is still called exactly once, in subscription order. `publish` keeps returning the number of handlers it called.
